description.zh: 白名单ID列表，英文逗号分割。
description.en: The list of whitelist IDs, separated by commas (,).

description.zh:
版本类型，支持：

- **FOTA**：系统升级
- **APP**：应用升级
description.en:
The version type. Valid values:

- **FOTA**: system upgrade.
- **APP**: application upgrade.

title.zh: 删除系统版本或应用版本设备白名单
title.en: Delete device whitelists of a system version or application version

descriptions.zh: > 当希望根据ID删除版本的设备白名单时，可以调用此接口。
descriptions.en: > Call this operation to delete device whitelists of a version by ID.
